title.narrative: Engagement of women and vulnerable groups in water related management issues

description.narrative: Engagement of women and vulnerable groups in water related management issues

comment.narrative: 30 increase

Women engagement is highly increased 60 in EUISWM project activities. Limited consideration of people with disabilities and vulnerable groups. Institutional staff is from various backgrounds and living under different socialeconomic conditions in different locations of the country. There are no records of employees with physical disabilities among WRMA staff. In addition the RBCs operate with nominated membership chaired by the Prefect of the biggest region in a given river basin area. Among the 7 RBCs in the country there are no records of people with physical disabilities.
